Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local

Class ConceptMapStore

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.ConceptMapStore
public final class ConceptMapStore extends Object
Reads an imported FHIR ConceptMap as the rows of a concept map relation, on demand, from the concept_mapping rows of one version of the map. The rows, together with the fault the importer recorded in the manifest where the map cannot be carried as a relation, hold what ConceptMapContent.fromResource(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ConceptMap, int) needs, so the content read is what it would make of the imported resource, which the store does not keep.

A map with a fault is rejected before any of its rows are read. Otherwise only the rows of the chosen version's partition are read, and reading stops once there are more distinct rows than the caller's cap, so a map too large for the caller costs memory in proportion to the cap rather than to the map.

Author:
John Grimes

  • Method Details

    • read

      @Nonnull public static Optional<ConceptMapContent> read(@Nonnull TerminologyStoreReader reader, @Nonnull String url, @Nullable String version, @Nonnull VersionResolver versionResolver, int maxMappings)
      Reads a concept map by canonical URL and optional version. A pinned version selects exactly that version; an absent version selects the only version, or the latest of several under the version-ordering rules the store applies to value sets.
      Parameters:
      reader - the store reader
      url - the canonical URL
      version - the requested version, or null for the latest
      versionResolver - the resolver that selects the latest of several versions
      maxMappings - the largest number of rows the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the content, or empty if the store holds no map at the URL and version
      Throws:
      ConceptMapVersionException - if several versions are held and no latest can be determined
      ConceptMapContentException - if the content of the map cannot be represented, for the reason ConceptMapContent.fromResource(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ConceptMap, int) would give
      ConceptMapLimitExceededException - if the map has more than maxMappings rows and its content can otherwise be represented
